200.description: The API process is responding.
Configuration and PostgreSQL are ready.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable.

200.description: Current API, database, Graph, and RAG status.

get.description: Returns the non-sensitive desired and active model settings, per-process applied revisions, and rollout state. API keys, ciphertext, key identifiers, nonces, and instance identifiers are never returned. Bearer API Tokens cannot access this system-secret management endpoint.

200.description: Current desired, active, runtime, rollout, and capability projections.

Cache-Control.description: Model configuration projections must not be stored by browsers or intermediaries.

put.description: Creates a new immutable desired revision. Saving does not change the active revision; the activation endpoint applies an exact saved revision in the existing API and Worker processes. Bearer API Tokens cannot access this system-secret management endpoint.

200.description: The desired revision was saved. Active and applied revisions remain authoritative and may still differ.

Cache-Control.description: Model configuration projections must not be stored by browsers or intermediaries.

post.description: Starts or idempotently observes an in-process activation for the exact desired revision. The request never carries model settings, credentials, endpoints, rollout identifiers, or client-selected phases. Request cancellation stops only the HTTP wait; the durable activation continues. Bearer API Tokens cannot access this system-secret management endpoint.

202.description: The exact target is durably started, already live, or already active and healthy. The body is a fresh authoritative Settings snapshot.

Cache-Control.description: Model activation projections must not be stored by browsers or intermediaries.

post.description: Tests exactly one Chat or Embedding draft from the API container without persisting it. Failures may include only bounded, sanitized Provider or transport diagnostics; credentials, endpoints, request bodies, raw responses, and internal errors are never echoed. Every response uses Cache-Control: no-store. Bearer API Tokens cannot access this system-secret management endpoint.

200.description: The selected provider accepted the bounded connection test and matched the requested model contract. The response includes only a fixed API style/path and non-negative elapsed milliseconds; it never includes the configured base URL or provider output.

Cache-Control.description: Connection-test results must not be stored by browsers or intermediaries.

post.description: Schedules a new durable processing run for a retryable terminal Capture without changing its immutable input. A new retry returns 202; an exact replay returns 200.

post.description: Creates an empty, Workspace-scoped Working Draft. A new command returns 201; an exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the original durable draft with 200.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key replay of the persisted Working Draft.

201.description: The empty Working Draft and its command receipt were committed.

get.description: Returns a Workspace-bound, stable keyset page of server-persisted Working Draft summaries. Draft bodies are retrieved only through the detail endpoint. The opaque cursor is bound to the Workspace, status filter, and limit.

get.description: Returns one Workspace-bound Working Draft for server-backed editing recovery.

200.description: Workspace-bound Working Draft.

put.description: CAS-updates the mutable Working Draft. expected_version is mandatory; stale updates and Idempotency-Key reuse with different content return 409 without silently overwriting the server version.

200.description: CAS-updated Working Draft or an exact Idempotency-Key replay.

post.description: Validates and atomically freezes a Working Draft into a Document Draft and immutable Article Revision. A new freeze returns 201; an exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the same identities with 200.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key replay of the frozen Document and Article Revision.

201.description: The Working Draft update, Document Draft, Article Revision, and freeze receipt were committed atomically.

post.description: Creates the controlled file_patch Proposal from the frozen server-owned Article Revision. It never accepts client content, path, base hash, or Proposal fields. A new binding returns 201; an exact successful Idempotency-Key replay returns it with 200. A deterministic missing-parent failure abandons the reservation; the same key stably replays WRITEBACK_TARGET_PARENT_NOT_FOUND with 404, and recovery requires correcting the path, freezing a new Revision, and using a new key.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key replay of the immutable publication binding.

201.description: A file_patch Proposal and immutable publication binding were committed from the frozen Revision.

get.description: Returns one Workspace-bound Document Draft, its latest frozen Article Revision when present, and its publication recovery state when present.

200.description: Workspace-bound Document Draft detail.

get.description: Returns a bounded path history bound to the current Document version, branch and HEAD. The opaque cursor is process-local and becomes stale when any bound fact changes.

200.description: Stable Document history page.

get.description: Returns complete bounded contents and a unified patch for two verified versions of the current canonical Document path.

200.description: Complete bounded comparison.

post.description: Re-reads the current Git and Document baseline and returns a server-derived restore preview. It never writes the worktree or creates a Proposal.

200.description: Server-derived restore preview.

post.description: Re-verifies the preview against the current Document and Git facts, then creates a governed restore_document Proposal containing only server-read target bytes. An exact Idempotency-Key replay returns 200.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key replay of the restore Proposal.

201.description: New governed restore_document Proposal.

get.description: Returns bounded, server-owned Authoring overview projections. Working Draft bodies and browser-local draft state are never included.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last acknowledged transient draft chunk as generation:sequence. A cursor from an older generation receives reset and end; a future or malformed cursor is rejected.

200.description: Transient final-answer draft SSE. Only chunk frames carry an id (generation:sequence). reset/end require the client to discard the draft and refetch the authoritative Answer; this stream never carries durable Server Events or a published Answer body.

parameters.description: Bootstrap cursor for a newly constructed browser EventSource. A valid Last-Event-ID header takes precedence while this query value is still validated.

parameters.description: Set to message to omit the dynamic SSE event field and dispatch every envelope as the browser's default message event. Omission preserves the legacy named-event wire format.

parameters.description: Browser-managed reconnect cursor. When present and valid, it takes precedence over last_event_id.

200.description: SSE stream. Each data field is a ServerEventEnvelope and heartbeat comments carry no data. The default legacy format includes event: <Envelope.type>; event_format=message omits event: so browsers dispatch the default message event.
